analyst_view.overall: Shakhtar (21st, 4 points) host Fenerbahçe (19th, 5 points) in London, where they play because of the war, so there is little real home advantage; both need points to stay in play-off contention. Shakhtar, under Arda Turan, are without Pedrinho (counted, a big -14% on their goals) and young striker Kaua Elias, who needed surgery on a broken metatarsal in early November and is described as one of their key attackers; the numbers don't list Elias. Fenerbahçe, under Emre Belözoğlu since early November, are without Nathan Aké (counted), Jayden Oosterwolde and Marco Asensio, who has been out since 10 October after cartilage surgery and so is already absent from their recent form; Milan Skriniar is fit. No referee is named yet. Since my last view I learned Asensio's absence is long-standing, so I no longer cut for it; only Elias moves my view.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals and already take Pedrinho off Shakhtar (-14%) while adding a little for Aké missing at Fenerbahçe's back. Kaua Elias's foot surgery is not in the numbers, but he has missed a couple of games already, so I trim only a little, to about 2.6. Asensio has been out since October, so his absence is already in Fenerbahçe's form.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, already raised about 12% for Shakhtar's busy recent corner count and trimmed 9% for Fenerbahçe's. Belözoğlu's side are still settling and a ground in London takes some of Shakhtar's push away, but nothing points clearly either way, so I stay at 9.2.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards, a high figure that reflects Fenerbahçe's card-heavy style (about 3 a game) and both sides' records. A must-win feel for both could keep it tense, but the numbers already carry that style and no referee has been named, so I stay at 4.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.4 shots, with Shakhtar's recent shooting run already adding about 15% to their side and Fenerbahçe's trimmed 9%. Last time I cut for Asensio, but he has been out since October, so that is in the form; Elias's loss shows more in finishing than in volume. I stay at about 26.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 shots on target. Without Kaua Elias, which the numbers don't see, Shakhtar lean more on Alisson and the wide players, who have been wasteful in Europe, so I trim slightly, to about 8.5.
